heading: Pattern sequencing — `then ... within`
text:
### Pattern sequencing — `then ... within` [RLOW.5.6]

A two-step `A then B within T` sequence compiles to `A`'s
alpha node joined to `B`'s alpha node through a beta node
whose join test enforces the strict-after and
within-duration constraints (`B.ts > A.ts and B.ts - A.ts <
T`).
